Tauri 2.0 Stable Release

tauri.ubitools.com/blog/tauri-20/     2024-10-02T00:00:00.0000000
This August we published the release candidate version of 2.0 to iron out major bugs and to get more feedback from productive use. At the same time the external audit was concluded and made public. The release candidate time frame was considerably shorter and consisted mainly of high impact bugfixes and documentation improvements.
